title: Morphotype 2 is most ciliated; morphotype 3 has the most polarized cilia

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Morphotype 2 is most ciliated; morphotype 3 has the most polarized cilia

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: Among the three Anthrobot morphotypes, morphotype 2 (the largest and least regular) is significantly more ciliated than the other two, and morphotype 3 has a significantly more polarized, clustered cilia distribution with the fewest isolated cilia patches.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: Motile Living Biobots Self-Construct from Adult Human Somatic Progenitor Seed Cells

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Gumuskaya G 2024, Motile Living Biobots Self-Construct from Adult Human Somatic Progenitor Seed Cells › Results › Anthrobots Self‐Organize into Distinct Morphological Types

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: These four indices together describe type 2 bots as being significantly more ciliated than type 1 and type 3 bots, and type 3 bots as having a significantly more polarized cilia distribution pattern (with the least amount of extra‐cluster noise) in comparison to type 1 and type 2 bots (Figure 3D).

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Gumuskaya G, Srivastava P, Cooper BG, Lesser H, Semegran B, Garnier S, Levin M, “Motile Living Biobots Self-Construct from Adult Human Somatic Progenitor Seed Cells”, Advanced science (Weinheim, Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany) (2024), doi:10.1002/advs.202303575; section “Results › Anthrobots Self‐Organize into Distinct Morphological Types”. Scope: About 350 NHBE-derived Anthrobots

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2024-anthrobots-12: partially-resolvable, resolvability 0.73

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The quantities and comparisons are precisely defined. Public summaries and code support auditing, but unavailable complete image data and cluster circularity limit independent resolution.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Recompute cilia density, polarity, and noise indices from the 3D stacks and compare their distributions across independently reproduced morphotype assignments.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Morphotypes and tested indices are derived from the same observations.

The complete 350 confocal stacks may not be downloadable.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
data adequacy: 0.56
discriminating power: 0.78
analysis feasibility: 0.78
data existence: 0.62
operationalizability: 0.96

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Coverage and polarization are explicit image measurements, and the paper reports both contrasts as significant. The feature table from the confocal cohort was not released. Re-running the group tests requires that table or a new imaging set; the published summary plot is not enough to recompute the differences.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: On the confocal cohort, compare cilia-coverage fraction and a polarization index across the three morphotypes. Morphotype 2 higher on coverage, and morphotype 3 higher on polarization with fewer isolated patches, would support the contrasts; overlapping distributions would refute them.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Significance depends on how the three groups were cut.

Cilia masks and the eight indices for the roughly 350 bots are not deposited.

Polarization and coverage are correlated with size, which also defines the types.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:

discriminating power: 0.58
operationalizability: 0.88
analysis feasibility: 0.2
data existence: 0.16
